requirement.summary: POS Function - Duty Meal / On Credit Limits - Allow Decimal Values for Payment Method Limit Balance
requirement.description:
User Story

As an administrator, I want to enter decimal values for Duty Meal and On Credit limit settings so that I can configure precise balance limits that match real-world fractional currency amounts.

Current Behavior

The POS configuration for Duty Meal and On Credit limit settings only accepts positive integer values. Administrators cannot enter or save amounts with decimal places (e.g., 10.50, 25.75). The existing 'Duty Meal/On Credit User Group Shop Limit Setting' and 'Duty Meal/On Credit User Shop Limit Setting' CBL settings already support unrestricted decimal places and serve as the reference pattern.

Expected Behavior

All eight Duty Meal and On Credit limit settings should accept positive decimal values with no cap on the number of decimal places, matching the existing 'Duty Meal/On Credit User Group Shop Limit Setting' and 'Duty Meal/On Credit User Shop Limit Setting' CBL settings. Values should be saved exactly as entered. The affected settings are: Duty Meal User Group Payment Method Limit, Duty Meal Shop Limit, Duty Meal Outlet Limit, Duty Meal Check Limit, On Credit User Group Payment Method Limit, On Credit Shop Limit, On Credit Outlet Limit, and On Credit Check Limit.

Acceptance Criteria

Enter decimal value for Duty Meal limit settings

- Given a Duty Meal limit setting (User Group Payment Method, Shop, Outlet, or Check) is open

- When the administrator enters a positive decimal value such as 10.50

- Then the value is accepted and saved exactly as entered

- And the value is displayed and processed correctly throughout the POS application

Enter decimal value for On Credit limit settings

- Given an On Credit limit setting (User Group Payment Method, Shop, Outlet, or Check) is open

- When the administrator enters a positive decimal value such as 25.75

- Then the value is accepted and saved exactly as entered

- And the value is displayed and processed correctly throughout the POS application

Unrestricted decimal places

- Given a Duty Meal or On Credit limit setting is open

- When the administrator enters a value with multiple decimal places such as 10.999

- Then the value is saved exactly as entered with no cap on decimal places

- And the behavior matches the existing 'Duty Meal/On Credit User Group Shop Limit Setting' and 'Duty Meal/On Credit User Shop Limit Setting' settings

Existing integer values remain supported

- Given a Duty Meal or On Credit limit setting is open

- When the administrator enters a positive integer value such as 10

- Then the value is accepted and saved without changes

- But if the administrator enters a negative value or non-numeric text, the value is rejected and not saved

- And if the administrator enters zero, the value is rejected and not saved

Supporting Evidence

Jira Case Reference: HERO-62752

Zoho Desk Number: 255139001004309614

Requested Timeline

Aligned with Priority: Medium

Preferred Quarter: Not specified

Notes: No fixed deadline provided by requester.

Alternatives Considered

Capping decimal places at standard currency precision (2 decimal places) was considered, but the requester confirmed the number of decimal places should be unrestricted, matching the existing 'Duty Meal/On Credit User Group Shop Limit Setting' and 'Duty Meal/On Credit User Shop Limit Setting' CBL settings.

Original Description (preserved by INF Prod. Studio)

Enhancement Details

Similar to CBL 'Duty Meal/On Credit User Group Shop Limit Setting' and 'Duty Meal/On Credit User Shop Limit Setting'

All other Duty Meal and On Credit limit CBL setting should support no limit decimal place setting.

Existing example as mentioned above:

This enhancement is request to support allowing to set decimal places for below CBL with no limit on the number of decimal places as above sample:

- Duty Meal User Group Payment Method Limit

- Duty Meal Shop Limit

- Duty Meal Outlet Limit

- Duty Meal Check Limit

- On Credit User Group Payment Method Limit

- On Credit Shop Limit

- On Credit Outlet Limit

- On Credit Check Limit

_______________________________________________________________________________________________{}

Requested Enhancement

Jira Case Reference: https://jira.shijidev.com/browse/HERO-62752

Modify the POS configuration to allow decimal values for the following payment method limits:

- Duty Meal Payment Method Limit Balance

- On Credit User Group Payment Method Limit Balance

- User Module Information (Duty Meal and On Credit)

- Config By Location:

- Duty Meal Shop Limit

- Duty Meal Outlet Limit

- Duty Meal Check Limit

- Duty Meal User Group Shop Limit Setting

- Duty Meal User Shop Limit Setting

- Duty Meal User Group Payment Method Limit

- On Credit Shop Limit

- On Credit Outlet Limit

- On Credit Check Limit

- On Credit User Group Shop Limit Setting

- On Credit User Shop Limit Setting

- On Credit User Group Payment Method Limit

Zoho Desk Number: https://support-intl.shijigroup.com/agent/shijigroupintl/infrasys-support/tickets/details/255139001004309614

Current Behavior

- Field accepts positive integers only.

- Decimal values (e.g., 10.50, 25.75) cannot be entered or saved.

Expected Behavior

- Field should accept positive decimal values.

- Support standard currency precision (e.g., up to 2 decimal places).

- Existing integer values should continue to be supported without changes.

Business Justification Allowing decimal values provides greater flexibility and accuracy when configuring Duty Meal and On Credit payment limits. This aligns the configuration with real-world currency requirements and prevents administrators from being restricted to whole-number amounts only.

Example

| Scenario
| Current Result
| Expected Result

| Limit = 10
| Accepted
| Accepted

| Limit = 10.50
| Rejected
| Accepted

| Limit = 25.75
| Rejected
| Accepted

Acceptance Criteria

- Users can enter positive decimal values for Duty Meal Payment Method Limit Balance.

- Users can enter positive decimal values for On Credit User Group Payment Method Limit Balance.

- System validates and saves decimal values successfully.

- Existing integer values remain supported.

- Decimal values are correctly displayed and processed throughout the POS application.

- No impact on existing configurations or payment workflows.
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancements: [Jira-67963/Epic-62750] POS Function - Duty Meal / On Credit Limits - Allow Decimal Values for Payment Method Limit Balance (Jamey)
Descriptions:
System supports decimal places input for duty meal and on credit limit in the setting below:
Config by Location
Duty Meal Shop Limit
Duty Meal Outlet Limit
Duty Meal Check Limit
Duty Meal User Group Payment Method Limit
On Credit Shop Limit
On Credit Outlet Limit
On Credit Check Limit
On Credit User Group Payment Method Limit
User Module (User Management  Users)
Users > Module Information > POS System > Duty Meal Limit
Users > Module Information > POS System > On Credit Limit
Remarks:
The rounding method and rounding decimal of payment amount are controlled by Outlet Settings
Even if duty meal and on credit limits support decimal places, the payment amount is still limited by the rounding setting configured in Outlet Settings
Example:
The limit of duty meal or on credit limit is 999.9999
The payment decimal places are 2 and round down in Outlet Settings
Then final payment amount become 999.99
Setup:
None
